component.name: Glint
component.summary: Capture, annotate and record your screen

description.p: Glint is a screenshot and screen-recording tool for KDE Plasma on Wayland, inspired by CleanShot X. It lives in the system tray and is driven by global shortcuts.

ul.li: Capture an area, window, display or the previous area, with a magnifier
Quick Access thumbnails to copy, save, annotate, pin or drag captures
Annotate with arrows, shapes, text, blur, pixelate, spotlight and counters
Pin screenshots on top of other windows
Scrolling capture, self-timer and text recognition (OCR)
Record the screen as MP4 or GIF with click highlighting, then trim it

screenshot.caption: Annotate and frame screenshots: blur secrets, number steps, add arrows and backgrounds
Area capture with magnifier, pixel colour and live size
The annotation editor: every tool one keypress away
Trim recordings and export MP4 or GIF
Quick Access Overlay: copy, save, annotate, pin or drag captures
Make Glint your Print Screen tool

description.p: New app ID (io.github.baldybuilds.Glint) with automatic migration of your shortcuts and settings, a log file for bug reports, and screenshots in software centres.
Fixes screen recording and GIFs failing with "Recording pipeline failed to start".
Glint can become your Print Screen tool, global shortcuts are native on KDE Plasma, and the record shortcut no longer clashes with Spectacle.
First release: captures, annotation, pinning, scrolling capture, OCR, recording with click highlighting and video trimming.
